method.axes: Blender world XYZ, Z up, metres. Distal finger joint origins are knuckle landmarks.
method.sampling: One sample per 1/30 s plus exact endpoints and quarter times, on the imported active NLA action alone. Every reported orientation uses the shortest unsigned quaternion angle in world space.
method.landmarks: Shiva foot floor uses mesh vertices below rest Z 0.15 m with >75% combined foot/toe weights. The sole patch includes the lowest 5 mm in rest. Krishna distances are closest vertex-pair distances between the deformed painted-lip geometry and each of eight rigid dark marker surfaces. Markers are ordered by their exported spacing along the bore. Each index pad is a proxy at 80% along its distal joint, measured to the centre of its assigned marker. Rigid landmark offsets use the authoring geometry.
